title: GPT-5.3-Codex System Card
summary: GPT‑5.3-Codex is the most capable agentic coding model to date, combining the frontier coding performance of GPT‑5.2-Codex with the reasoning and professional knowledge capabilities of GPT‑5.2.
body: GPT‑5.3-Codex is the most capable agentic coding model to date, combining the frontier coding performance of GPT‑5.2-Codex with the reasoning and professional knowledge capabilities of GPT‑5.2.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布的GPT-5.3-Codex系统卡片（System Card）显示，该模型是迄今为止能力最强的智能体编程模型。它完美结合了GPT-5.2-Codex的顶级编程性能，以及GPT-5.2的深度推理与专业知识储备，全面提升了自动化软件工程水平。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI公布GPT-5.3-Codex系统卡片，详细阐述了迄今最强智能体编程模型的架构与能力。
